subject: general
question:
Which of the following statements of force is/are correct?

A. Weight is a force that acts vertically downward on an object.

B. Thrust is the force acting on an object perpendicular to the surface.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Both 'A' and 'B' are correct**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Weight (Statement A):**

 
 
• Weight is indeed a force. Specifically, it's the force of gravity acting on an object's mass.
 
• This force is always directed towards the center of the Earth, hence "vertically downward."
 
• Weight is measured in Newtons (N), just like any other force.
 
• The magnitude of weight is calculated using the formula: Weight (W) = mass (m) × acceleration due to gravity (g).
